rawResponse.aboutCopy: For over 25 years, Princeton Dental has been Kenmore's trusted family dental clinic. Dr Nina Ong and Dr Luke Dodd treat every patient like family — straightforward, honest "everyday" dentistry with no pressure to buy services you don't need. Whether you're nervous about the dentist or just due for a check-up, you'll get clear explanations, a calm chair-side manner, and affordable care for every generation of your family.
